result:
Frontend functional QA complete. **Run 114 — 0 app defects found, 0 fixes needed, 0 commits.**

## What was tested

Every page in the charter was driven with real interactions, not just rendered — this discharges last night's #1 priority (the frontend charter was completely unmeasured on 08-31).

| Area | Result |
|---|---|
| 18/18 routes render | PASS — `<h1>` on all, 1 `.nav-link.is-active`, **0 page errors** |
| /dashboard | 6 stat cards + 14 funnel tiles all navigate; date-range control refetches |
| /leads | search, all 4 filters (correct query params + row deltas), sort DESC→ASC, 25/50/100 |
| lead detail | Score Breakdown, Log Activity, stage/roof pickers, Storm History, FEMA, Insurance Report |
| /pipeline | **HTML5 drag works both ways** (`PATCH {"stage":"contacted"}`, dragged back) |
| /estimates | builder line items → Subtotal $600.00, margin cost $420/profit $180; Review toolbar 4/4 live (PDF really downloads) |
| /invoices | Record Payment modal honours a typed amount (`{"amount":1,…}`) |
| /work-orders | detail overlay, Milestones (0/7), all 7 mark-complete buttons |
| /tasks | tabs, priority mapping, overdue badge, toggle→PATCH, create→POST |
| /calendar, /reports, /canvassing, /storm-map | 4 views + real-pointer dateClick; 5 presets; Drop Pin→New Pin w/ GPS; 5 layer toggles |
| /settings | **15/15 tabs** + 8 interactions |

`npx vite build` → exit 0, 7.97s.

## Notable

**All 8 apparent "dead controls" were my own selector errors**, not app bugs — e.g. `Record Payment` lives in the invoice *editor* not the row; all 6 Settings create controls are inline forms with no overlay; the 0×0 "Keyboard shortcuts" button on map routes is **Google's**, not the app's. Each is now recorded as a trap.

**Closed a 3-run-open lead:** the builder-level jsonb type-confusion sweep — 17 keys rewritten to truthy non-arrays on every response, then each builder opened — came back **0 white screens, 0 page errors, 8/8 flows**. The `Array.isArray` guards from earlier runs hold at the detail level too.

**Net-zero DB writes:** only 2 self-cancelling stage PATCHes; tasks, estimate save, and the payment were all driven through `page.route` stubs. No screenshot added to the repo (the one taken hit the repo root, confirming that trap, and was moved to `C:/tmp`).

Artifact at `C:/tmp/frontend-test-results.txt` and `/tmp/frontend-test-results.txt` (both fresh, 20 sections). Memory files updated: `overnight_resume.md`, `qa_standing_gotchas.md`, `MEMORY.md`.
